title: [Sutana's Designs, Walls]
description: Broad display frames line the room, each fitted with large wall sections showcasing different woods, finishes, and treatments.  Some panels are left smooth or knotted, while others bear scorch marks, stamped patterns, or brushed metallic accents.  Lantern light rakes across the surfaces at an angle, bringing out grain, seams, and subtle imperfections.  Low benches and labeled trays hold smaller samples for closer inspection of texture, color, and workmanship.
